S8 velocity sensitivity: the per-drum curve is applied at the INGEST seam (VoiceEngineHost.toInputEvent server-side, the offline fire builders in the web store), not inside the voice engine. Rationale: the engine holds a Show (authored content) and never the inputMap, so curving there would have meant pushing input config into Show; at ingest the raw value and the zone-map's resolved drum already coexist, and the note/OSC value tables downstream inherit the shaped value — the drum's sensitivity is a property of the drum, not of one consumer. Corollary rule: a zone-map-CLAIMED input is shaped, an unclaimed one (direct-bound note, modulation-only address) passes through untouched; fireGraph is uncurved because it carries a graph key, not an input identity.
